exact_native_boundary: MetaCyc PWY-5901 complete three-reaction pathway; PathBank SMP0000774 is a broader mixed map and is not asserted exactMatch

assemblies.scope: Explicit modified native state; not a requirement for modification in lyase catalysis
assemblies.historical_discrepancy: Earlier trimer/pentamer estimates are retained in native comment; current source dimer selected

assemblies.scope: Selected tetramer; 2011 concentration-dependent dimer-tetramer equilibrium; 1989 octamer gel-filtration estimate and PathBank8 kept as conflict

deliberate_exclusions.reason: Upstream of independently verified PWY-5901 input
Downstream oxidative branch beyond independently verified DHB endpoint
Historical EntA octamer estimate; not selected current native tetramer; no silent sameAs assertion
Multienzyme downstream process outside this native pathway; not assigned to EntB alone

deliberate_exclusions.object: EntD maturation, EntE loading, EntF synthase, carrier-domain phosphopantetheine substrate
deliberate_exclusions.reason: Separate carrier-domain chemistry; holo component state preserved without adding outside-boundary reactions
Explicitly excluded native isozymes; no MenF mechanism imported into EntC pathway

deliberate_exclusions.object: Transient C3-keto intermediate and aromatization substep
deliberate_exclusions.reason: Already included once in selected net Rhea23825; adding a second decomposition reaction double counts net conversion

deliberate_exclusions.object: Obligate channeling and fixed EntC/EntB assembly
deliberate_exclusions.reason: Pairwise interaction measured; channeling is potential/model-supported, no fixed complete assembly identity verified
Native protein annotation concerns carrier/enterobactin synthase context; not evidence that the entire three-step pathway is membrane localized
Reversibility was demonstrated for analogues, not aromatic DHB physiology
